instruction: A candid documentary photograph captured in a medium shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. In a bright indoor playroom with a white wall and a yellow beanbag, three children play tug-of-war. On the right, the girl in the white floral top (R3) stands facing left, pulling a green rope taut with both hands. On the left, the boy in the white t-shirt (R2) sits on the beanbag, leaning back to pull the rope. Behind him, the girl in the orange t-shirt (R1) also sits on the beanbag, holding the rope to assist. The scene is illuminated by soft, bright indoor light, creating a warm and playful atmosphere.
